intent: Present a delivery flow on the left with key outcome metrics on the right, ending with a call-to-action bar.
invariants: two panels split 5:7 (left narrower for flow, right wider for outcomes)
left panel has sequential flow steps with accent_1 vertical bars
each flow step has bold title and caption description
right panel has a 2x2 outcome metric grid with accent bars
each metric cell has large value (24pt Space Grotesk bold) and caption label
CTA bar at bottom of right panel with accent_1 fill and accent_2 left bar
variables: header bar kicker and title text
limitations: Original slide may use custom connector shapes or arrows between steps
Icon elements within flow steps are not reproduced
Complex connector routing is simplified to vertical lines
